name: CJ Corporation
summary: CJ Corporation engages in the food and food services, bio, logistics and retail, and entertainment and media businesses worldwide. It manufactures and sells food and beverages, and functional flavoring; cultivates crops; operates restaurants and bar; wholesales, retails, and e-commerce sale of bay salt; process meats; produces and sells frozen and refrigerated processed foods; distributes food ingredients; and farms livestock, as well as manufactures and sells feeds.
